abilities.name: Frozen Wilds
_curatorNotes: Behavior changed from 'stance' (generator stub) to 'instant': Rushing Ice gives cryo infusion to normals but does not replace normal-attack animations or move normals/charge to a new ability — not a stance per recipe rule. Rushing Ice is a 10s self-state triggered indirectly by 4 Coil stacks accumulating after the Freeze Bomb/Bomblets land.

Generator variants[] removed. The two entries [{ label: 'ATK Decrease', duration: 6 }, { label: 'Rushing Ice', duration: 10 }] were duration-bearing state windows, not tap/hold input variants. ATK Decrease is a 6s enemy ATK debuff; Rushing Ice is a 10s cryo-infusion + NA DMG bonus state. Neither is a distinct cast input. Reviewer to model as effects.

Rushing Ice infusion: when 4 Coil stacks accumulate, gcsim calls AddWeaponInfuse(Cryo, 600f, AttackTagNormal) giving all normals cryo infusion for 10s, plus a NA DMG bonus (skillRushingIceNABonus: ~29.2% at TL1). The NormalAbility.infusion field is documented for stance normals (e.g. Cyno); this is a conditional skill-window infusion with no direct input variant. Reviewer to decide representation (conditional infusion effect, or schema extension).

ATK Decrease effect not yet authored: Chillwater Bomblets that hit enemies reduce opponent ATK (12–15% scaling with TL1–15) for 6s. Generator emitted effects: [] on skill. Reviewer to add enemy debuff entry.
abilities.description:
Aloy throws a Freeze Bomb in the targeted direction that explodes on impact, dealing Cryo DMG. After it explodes, the Freeze Bomb will split up into many Chillwater Bomblets that explode on contact with opponents or after a short delay, dealing Cryo DMG.
When a Freeze Bomb or Chillwater Bomblet hits an opponent, the opponent's ATK is decreased and Aloy receives 1 Coil stack.
Aloy can gain up to 1 Coil stack every 0.1s.

Coil
·Each stack increases Aloy's Normal Attack DMG.
·When Aloy has 4 Coil stacks, all stacks of Coil are cleared. She then enters the Rushing Ice state, which further increases the DMG dealt by her Normal Attacks and converts her Normal Attack DMG to Cryo DMG.

While in the Rushing Ice state, Aloy cannot obtain new Coil stacks.
Coil effects will be cleared 30s after Aloy leaves combat.

Grants Aloy +16% ATK and all party members +8% ATK for 10s (rushingIceDuration = 600f), refreshing on each stack. passives.name: Strong Strike
_curatorNotes: Consolidated from two start/cap skeleton effects into one ramping BuffValue (gcsim a4: +3.5%/s over the 10s Rushing Ice window, cap 35%). Trigger stays manual — a4 actually fires when the 4th Coil stack activates Rushing Ice, which needs a coil-stack condition the schema doesn't gate yet.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). passive: Strong Strike — effects[0] (buff cryoDmgBonus, ramping 3.5→35) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `~/Code/gcsim/internal/characters/aloy/skill.go:131-154` — `coilStacks` is the bomblet/bomb AttackCB: +1 Coil per hit behind a 6-frame ICD, and at `c.coils == 4` it zeroes the counter and calls `rushingIce()` (`skill.go:157-175`), which adds the 600f `rushingIceKey` status and calls `a4()` (`asc.go:33-54`: one CryoP StatMod for `rushingIceDuration`, `stacks` incremented by ten 1s tasks, clamped at 10 → 35%). that Rushing Ice is the 4th Coil stack (gcsim `coils == 4 → coils = 0 → rushingIce()`), that `onStack` spending the set IS that zeroing, and that the E's three `application[]` entries (f25/31/37, 6f apart) each land one hit record, so one E grants three Coils at the authored 0.1s ICD and the threshold falls on the next cast's first bomblet — gcsim's default `bomblets: 2` gives the same shape. `scope: "rotation"` because the kit clears Coil only 30s after Aloy leaves combat, not on swap (the Alyosha `huntersMark` precedent). ⚠️ "While in the Rushing Ice state, Aloy cannot obtain new Coil stacks" (gcsim `skill.go:139-141`) is NOT expressible — there is no `rushingIce` State and minting one is two edits. Coils therefore keep accruing inside the window and could re-fire the threshold early; bounded in practice by the 20s E cooldown against the 10s window (~3 Coils per cast), so a re-fire needs two casts and cannot land inside one window. Rushing Ice's OTHER content (Cryo infusion on normals + the Normal Attack DMG bonus) is the skill's, still unauthored, and is not this effect's to carry.
passives.description: When Aloy is in the Rushing Ice state conferred by Frozen Wilds, her Cryo DMG Bonus increases by 3.5% every 1s. A maximum Cryo DMG Bonus increase of 35% can be gained in this way.
